# Almanac: Harbor View Condominium Association
Version: 4
Compiled: 2027-01-02
As of: 2027-01-02 (board local date)
Board folder: Board Documents
Sources: 18 processed, 0 excluded
Completeness: complete
Open conflicts: 1
Provisional items: 2
Model route: NAS local model

## At a glance

| Topic | Current rule | Since | Scheduled | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly fee and budget | $240 per unit per month | 2026-03-01 | none | adopted |
| Pets | Up to 2 per unit, registration required, no weight limit | 2025-04-15 | none | adopted |
| Renovations and work hours | Mon to Fri 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., no Sun or holidays | 2024-07-15 | none | adopted |
| Balconies and exterior fixtures | Fixtures need written approval; heat pumps allowed with conditions; barbecues prohibited (electric barbecues discussed, provisional) | 2025-01-23 | none | adopted |
| Quiet hours | 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.; Friday and Saturday nights 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. | 2026-10-01 | none | adopted |
| Rentals and leasing | Minimum lease 30 days | 2025-04-15 | none | adopted |
| Parking | Guest parking up to 24 hours | 2027-01-01 | none | adopted |
| Electric vehicle charging | Allowed in assigned space with approval and licensed electrician | 2026-01-20 (decision date) | none | adopted |
| Pool and amenities | 2026 season: 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. or 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.; other seasons: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., June 1 to September 15 | 2026 season; 2019-05-01 | none | conflict |
| Vendor contracts | Landscaping: Bramblewick Grounds, $1,450 per month, 4% renewal cap; non-renewal notice sent after the due date; whether the agreement ended is not established | 2024-04-01 | none | incomplete |
| Officers and elections | Board of President, Treasurer, Secretary; Treasurer appointed 2025-09-10 | 2025-09-10 | none | adopted |
| Governance and amendments | Bylaws: 2/3 of owners at annual meeting. House rules: majority of the board | 2019-05-01 | none | adopted |

## Monthly fee and budget

Current rule: $240 per unit per month.
Effective: 2026-03-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026"

Superseded:
- 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01: $225 per unit. Source: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $225 per unit, effective March 1, 2025" (3-0)
- Corrected: $230 stated in notice-2025-02-10-fees.pdf: "From March 1, 2025 the monthly common charge will be $230 per unit." Correction in minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "the notice of February 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error. The adopted charge is $225 per unit."
- 2024-03-01 to 2025-03-01: $210 per unit. Source: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $210 per unit, effective March 1, 2024" (3-0)
- Proposed, not adopted: $235 from 2025-03-01. Source: agenda-2025-01-23.pdf; minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "The proposed charge of $235 was amended."
- Informational, not a rule: newsletter-2025-12.pdf: "Many of you have asked whether charges will rise to $250 next year."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pets

Current rule: Up to 2 pets per unit. Registration with management is required. No weight limit for dogs.
Effective: 2025-04-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed; registration with management is still required."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: One pet per unit; dogs up to 35 lb. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet." and "Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Renovations and work hours

Current rule: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; no work on Sundays or holidays.
Effective: 2024-07-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-06-12, motio

n carried 3-0; restated in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf
Evidence: minutes-2024-06-12.docx: "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2024-07-15: Weekday hours 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; no work on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No work is permitted on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Balconies and exterior fixtures

Current rule: No fixtures, appliances or equipment on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval. Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies. Heat pump outdoor units are permitted with written board approval if floor-mounted, not attached to the railing, and rated at no more than 60 dB(A).
Effective: 2019-05-01 for fixtures and barbecues; 2025-01-23 (decision date, no effective date stated) for heat pumps
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01; Board meeting minutes, 2025-01-23, vote 2-1 for heat pumps
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval." and "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies."; minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval, provided they are floor-mounted and not attached to the railing, and have a rated sound level of no more than 60 dB(A)."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional:
- Electric barbecues: board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:10: "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." No vote taken; barbecues remain prohibited.

## Quiet hours

Current rule: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. on all nights other than Friday and Saturday nights. Friday and Saturday nights: 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
Effective: 2026-10-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-09-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-09-15.docx: "amend House Rule 6 so that quiet hours on Friday and Saturday nights are 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m." and "Quiet hours on all other nights remain 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Effective October 1, 2026."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026-10-01: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night. Replaced only for Friday and Saturday nights; still in force for other nights. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Rentals and leasing

Current rule: Minimum lease term is 30 days.
Effective: 2025-04-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 2-1
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately. Motion carried 2-1."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: Minimum six months. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Units may not be leased for a term of less than six (6) months."
- Failed: leases of seven days or more. Source: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "permit leases of seven (7) days or more. Motion failed 1-2."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Parking

Current rule: Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 24 hours. Each unit has one assigned space.
Effective: 2027-01-01 (scheduled change; in force since that date)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-11-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-11-10.docx: "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 24 hours. Effective January 1, 2027. Motion carried 3-0."

Superseded:
- 2025-10-01 to 2027-01-01: No more than 48 hours. Source: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025."
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-10-01: No more than 72 hours. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 72 hours."
- Assigned sp

aces, 2019-05-01 onward: "Each unit has one assigned space." Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Electric vehicle charging

Current rule: Owners may install a charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost.
Effective: 2026-01-20 (decision date, no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pool and amenities

Current rule: Conflict for the 2026 season. The adopted minutes set 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily; the 2026 pool notice gives 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily. Other seasons: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily, June 1 to September 15. The pool opened June 1, 2026.
Effective: 2026 season; other seasons 2019-05-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (2026 hours); Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01 (other seasons)
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily. Motion carried 3-0."; bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The pool is open 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026 season: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily, June 1 to September 15. Replaced for the 2026 season only by minutes-2025-09-10.pdf (see Open conflicts); still in force for other seasons.
- Informational: notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "The pool opens on June 1, 2026." newsletter-2025-12.pdf: "The pool is closed for the winter."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts:
- 2026 season closing hours. minutes-2025-09-10.pdf (adopted, 3-0): "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily." notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf (notice, informational): "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." A notice does not replace an adopted resolution; no later document resolves the difference.
Provisional:
- board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:45: "Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten." Deferred; not a rule.

## Vendor contracts

Current rule: Landscaping with Bramblewick Grounds LLC at $1,450 per month. Term April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026, renewing automatically for one-year terms unless written notice of non-renewal is given at least 60 days before the end of the term. Any renewal increase is capped at 4%. The Board voted not to renew and set a notice due date of January 30, 2026. The notice was sent February 2, 2026. Whether the agreement ended on March 31, 2026 or renewed is not established.
Effective: 2024-04-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-01-18, motion carried 3-0 (award); contract signed 2024-01-25
Evidence: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "award the landscaping contract to Bramblewick Grounds LLC on the terms of the attached agreement, for the period April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026."; contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Officers and elections

Current rule: The board has three directors (President, Treasurer, Secretary); quorum is two. The Treasurer resigned, and a new Treasurer was appointed on 2025-09-10 to serve until the next annual meeting.
Effective: 2025-09-10 (decision date, no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The Association is governed by a board of three directors: a President, a Treasurer and a Secretary. A quorum is two directors."; minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "The Treasurer resigned. The board appointed a new Treasurer to

serve until the next annual meeting. Motion carried 3-0."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Governance and amendments

Current rule: Part A of the bylaws may be amended only by a two-thirds vote of unit owners at an annual meeting. Part B (house rules) may be amended by a majority vote of the board. Monthly common charges are set by the board in the annual budget.
Effective: 2019-05-01
Set by: Bylaws and house rules adopted by unit owners, 2019-05-01
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting." and "The House Rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board."

Superseded: none
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Changelog

## v4, 2027-01-02
- Rebuilt from 18 files. New since v3: none. Changed since v3: none in the file list or checksums.
- Changed: Parking. Guest parking is now up to 24 hours, in force since 2027-01-01 (scheduled in v3). Previously up to 48 hours since 2025-10-01. Quote: minutes-2026-11-10.docx: "Effective January 1, 2027."
- Changed: Provisional items 1 to 2. Added the recording objection about pool hours (board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:45).
- No change to other topics or open items. No new conflicts. No exclusions.

End of almanac v4.
